params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly removes large blocks of commented-out code, which directly addresses the SonarQube warning about commented-out code sections. The deletions are focused on removing unused commented code and do not affect functional code. The other changes in the patch are minor comment formatting adjustments (changing floating-point literals from 2.0 to 2) which are acceptable as they do not alter functionality and are unrelated to the warning fix. There are no unrelated additions or deletions of code, no variable renaming, no print statement changes, and no optimizations that would warrant rejection.

Score: 3
